# Section 08 Highlights

## Highlight 1
**Headline:** 430 kit items configured but zero rep usage — largest feature utilization gap
**Context:** Kit items have been set up in the system but no rep has ever viewed or ordered a kit. This represents the widest gap between configuration investment and actual usage. Reintroducing kits through rep training could improve order efficiency and AOV.
**Section:** [§8 Platform & Feature Utilization](#platform)
**Priority Action Candidate:** YES
**Urgency:** LOW — No revenue at risk, but an untapped efficiency and AOV opportunity.

## Highlight 2
**Headline:** 7 data entities are 299 days stale — including price levels and sales quotas
**Context:** Sales quotas, price levels, contract prices, placement reports, commitment reports, payment information, and riser prices all last updated August 20, 2025. Stale price levels could mean reps work with outdated pricing structures.
**Section:** [§8 Platform & Feature Utilization](#platform)
**Priority Action Candidate:** YES
**Urgency:** MEDIUM — Stale pricing data can cause quoting errors; stale quotas reduce sales management visibility.

## Highlight 3
**Headline:** Product search accounts for 36% of all platform activity (70,189 events)
**Context:** Reps use the platform primarily as a search-and-discover tool. High library view count (13,279) paired with low email sharing (648) suggests reps view content on-device but rarely share digitally with customers. Sales Portal has only 31 access events despite being enabled.
**Section:** [§8 Platform & Feature Utilization](#platform)
